import hashlib, json, pathlib, shutil
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
evidence = root / "evidence" / "evaluator-tuple-checks-session"
evidence.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
backup = evidence / "original"
scratch = evidence / "restore-proof"
backup.mkdir()
scratch.mkdir()
rows = []
for name in ("orchestrate.py", "tests/test_orchestrate.py"):
    source = root / name
    saved = backup / name
    restored = scratch / name
    saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    restored.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, saved)
    shutil.copyfile(saved, restored)
    hashes = [hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (source, saved, restored)]
    if len(set(hashes)) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("backup restore differs: " + name)
    rows.append({"path": name, "sha256": hashes[0], "restored_matches": True})
print(json.dumps({"files": rows, "status": "restore_proven"}, sort_keys=True))

import hashlib, json, pathlib, re
root = pathlib.Path("evidence/evaluator-tuple-checks-session")
transcript = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "transcript.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
before = next(row for row in transcript if row["stderr"] == "02-before.stderr")
after = next(row for row in transcript if row["stderr"] == "03-after.stderr")
suite = next(row for row in transcript if row["stderr"] == "05-full-suite.stderr")
assert before["command"] == after["command"] and before["exit_code"] == 1 and after["exit_code"] == 0
suite_text = (root / suite["stderr"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert suite["exit_code"] == 0 and suite_text.rstrip().endswith("OK")
test_count = int(re.search(r"Ran (\d+) tests", suite_text).group(1))
results = {}
for route in ("reference", "fast", "strong"):
    directory = root / (route + "-verification")
    verification = json.loads((directory / "verification.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    verdict = json.loads((directory / "verifier.stdout").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / "events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    assert verdict["tests_run"] == 7 and verdict["errors"] == 0
    assert verification["command"][:2] == ["docker", "run"]
    assert "--network" in verification["command"] and "none" in verification["command"]
    if route == "reference":
        assert verification["exit_code"] == 0 and verdict["failures"] == 0 and events[-1]["event"] == "completed"
    else:
        assert verification["exit_code"] == 1 and verdict["failures"] == 3 and events[-1]["event"] == "failed"
        assert not any(event["event"] == "completed" for event in events)
        assert "each interval must be a two-element tuple" in (directory / "verifier.stderr").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    results[route] = {"exit_code": verification["exit_code"], "verdict": verdict, "terminal_event": events[-1]["event"],
                      "evaluator_sha256": events[1]["evaluator_sha256"]}
assert len({result["evaluator_sha256"] for result in results.values()}) == 1
for row in transcript:
    if row["stdout"] == "07-derive-candidate-inputs.stdout":
        for line in (root / row["stdout"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            derived = json.loads(line)
            assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(derived["source"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == derived["source_sha256"]
summary = {"schema_version": 1, "reproduction": {"command": before["command"], "before_exit": before["exit_code"], "after_exit": after["exit_code"]},
           "suite": {"command": suite["command"], "exit_code": suite["exit_code"], "tests_run": test_count,
                     "unedited_stdout": suite["stdout"], "unedited_stderr": suite["stderr"]},
           "sandbox_results": results, "model_calls": 0,
           "modified_sources": {name: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                for name in ("orchestrate.py", "tests/test_orchestrate.py")}}
with (root / "comparison.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True))
